verses.gurmukhi: ਜਟੂ ਭਾਨੂ ਤੀਰਥਾ ਚਾਇ ਚਈਲੇ ਚਢੇ ਚਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: jaToo bhaanoo teerathaa chai chieele chadde chaare|

en.bdb: Along with Nihala, Jattu, Bhanu and Tiratha of Chaddha caste love the Guru very dearly.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਣੇ ਨਿਹਾਲੇ ਜਾਣੀਅਨਿ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਸੇਵਕ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਿਆਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: sane nihaale jaaneean sanamukh sevak guroo piaare|

en.bdb: They are close servants who always remain before the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੇਖੜ ਸਾਧ ਵਖਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਉ ਭੁਲੂ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਚਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: sekhaR saadh vakhaane'eeh naau bhuloo sikh suchaare|

en.bdb: Nau and Bhallu are known as Sadhus of Sekhar caste and are Sikhs of good conduct.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜਟੂ ਭੀਵਾ ਜਾਣੀਅਨਿ ਮਹਾਂ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮੂਲਾ ਪਰਵਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: jaToo bheevaa jaaneean mahaa(n) purakh moolaa paravaare|

en.bdb: Jattu of Bhiva caste and the greatman Mula along with his family are the Sikhs of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਤੁਰਦਾਸੁ ਮੂਲਾ ਕਪੂਰੁ ਹਾੜੂ ਗਾੜੂ ਵਿਜ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: chaturadhaas moolaa kapoor haaRoo gaaRoo vij vichaare|

en.bdb: Chatur Das and Mula are kalpur Kshatryias and Haru and Garu belong to Vij caste.

verses.gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਣਾ ਬਹਿਲੁ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਜੇਠਾ ਚੰਗਾ ਕੁਲੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: firanaa bahil vakhaaneeaai jeThaa cha(n)gaa kul nisataare|

en.bdb: A Sikh named Phirana is of Bahal subcaste and Bhai Jetha is a pretty good liberator of the family.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਿਸਾ ਗੋਪੀ ਤੁਲਸੀਆ ਭਾਰਦੁਆਜੀ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਸਾਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: visaa gopee tulaseeaa bhaaradhuaajee sanamukh saare|

en.bdb: Vissa, Gopi, Tulasis et al. all belong to Bhardvaj (brahmin) family and always remain with the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਡਾ ਭਗਤੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਈਅੜਾ ਗੋਇੰਦੁ ਘੇਈ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੇ।
verses.translit_en: vaddaa bhagat hai bhaieeaRaa goi(n)dh gheiee guroo dhuaare|

en.bdb: Bhaiara and Govind are devotees belonging to Ghai Caste. They remain at the door of the Guru.
The perfect Guru has fetched across the world ocean.
